tip.liams_modpack.inventory_sort.text: Quark adds Sort buttons to supported inventories. Use Sort Inventory for your belongings and Sort Container for the open storage.
tip.liams_modpack.inventory_sort_binding: Use sorting often? Assign Quark's Sort Player Inventory and Sort Target Inventory actions in Controls > Key Binds.
tip.liams_modpack.inventory_transfer.tex: Quark's Insert and Extract buttons move items between your inventory and supported storage. Hover over a button to check its direction before clicking.
tip.liams_modpack.inventory_filtered_tra: Quark also offers filtered Insert and Extract buttons. Use these when you want to move matching supplies rather than everything.
tip.liams_modpack.inventory_search.text: Use Quark's Filter button in a supported storage screen to search its contents. Matching slots stand out without rearranging the inventory.
tip.liams_modpack.inventory_search_clear: If items look dim in a storage screen, check Quark's search field. Clear the search to see all slots normally again.
Quark's Hotbar Swapper can exchange your hotbar with an inventory row. Assign its action in Key Binds, then use the displayed row choices.
tip.liams_modpack.inventory_restock.text: Quark can restock a depleted held stack from your inventory. Keep spare building materials outside the hotbar if you want them available for restocking.
tip.liams_modpack.inventory_restock_tool: Quark's automatic tool restock can select a replacement when a held tool runs out. Check what you are holding before continuing delicate work.
tip.liams_modpack.crafting_rotate.text: Crafting Tweaks adds a Rotate Grid button to supported crafting screens. Rotate the ingredients instead of moving each stack by hand.
tip.liams_modpack.crafting_balance.text: Use Crafting Tweaks' Balance Grid button to even out matching ingredient stacks in the crafting grid.
tip.liams_modpack.crafting_spread.text: Crafting Tweaks has a Spread Grid action for distributing items through the crafting grid. You can assign it in Key Binds.
tip.liams_modpack.crafting_clear.text: Crafting Tweaks' Clear Grid action helps empty a crafting grid when you change recipes.
tip.liams_modpack.crafting_force_clear.t: Crafting Tweaks' Force Clear Grid can drop items when necessary. Make inventory space before using it.
tip.liams_modpack.crafting_bulk_result.t: With this pack's Crafting Tweaks settings, right-clicking a crafting-table result crafts a full stack when ingredients allow. Check the output before clicking.
tip.liams_modpack.crafting_compress.text: Crafting Tweaks has separate Compress Item, Compress Stack, and Compress All actions. Choose the scope you need before converting stored materials.
tip.liams_modpack.crafting_grid_required: Crafting Tweaks limits compression recipes to the open crafting grid's size here. Use a crafting table for recipes that need a full 3-by-3 grid.
tip.liams_modpack.recipe_book_button.tex: The crafting recipe book is available in this pack. Crafting Tweaks moves its button, so look beside the crafting controls if you do not see it in its usual spot.
tip.liams_modpack.recipe_book_filter.tex: Missing a known recipe in the recipe book? Check whether the craftable-only filter is hiding recipes that need more ingredients.
tip.liams_modpack.recipe_book_search.tex: Use the recipe book's search field to narrow down your unlocked recipes. Clear the field when switching to a different project.
tip.liams_modpack.recipe_book_unlocks.te: The recipe book shows recipes you have learned. An absent entry alone does not prove that an item cannot be crafted.
tip.liams_modpack.recipe_pack_changes.te: This pack changes a number of recipes. Use the recipes shown in this installation when outside guides give you a different ingredient list.
tip.liams_modpack.controls_conflicts.tex: Several mods share keybindings. If one key triggers the wrong action, open Controls > Key Binds and check for conflicting assignments.
tip.liams_modpack.controls_unbound.text: Some useful mod actions start unassigned. Browse Key Binds by mod name and assign the actions you actually use.
tip.liams_modpack.controls_mouse.text: Key Binds also accepts mouse buttons. Spare side buttons can put a frequently used action within easier reach.
tip.liams_modpack.controls_offhand.text: Use %s to swap your held item with your offhand. This can make frequent tool-and-material changes easier.
tip.liams_modpack.controls_screenshot.te: Use %s to save a picture of a build or a confusing screen before changing it.
tip.liams_modpack.controls_perspective.t: Use %s to change perspective when you want a better look at your outfit or nearby building work.
tip.liams_modpack.access_gui_scale.text: If inventory text or buttons are too small, adjust GUI Scale in Video Settings. Check a storage screen after changing it.
tip.liams_modpack.access_subtitles.text: Subtitles can help you notice nearby sound cues without turning up the volume. Enable them in Accessibility Settings.
tip.liams_modpack.access_view_bobbing.te: Turn down visual movement by disabling View Bobbing in Video Settings.
tip.liams_modpack.access_damage_tilt.tex: Accessibility Settings includes Damage Tilt. Reduce it if being hit makes the camera uncomfortable.
tip.liams_modpack.access_fov_effects.tex: Reduce FOV Effects in Accessibility Settings if changes in movement speed make the view uncomfortable.
The Screen Effects slider in Accessibility Settings reduces the intensity of effects such as portal distortion.
tip.liams_modpack.access_auto_jump.text: Auto-Jump is adjustable in Controls. Turn it off if it interferes with precise movement around builds.
tip.liams_modpack.access_toggle_movement: Accessibility Settings lets you choose toggle or hold behavior for sneaking and sprinting. Pick the option that is more comfortable for you.
tip.liams_modpack.access_high_contrast.t: Try the High Contrast option in Accessibility Settings if menu controls are difficult to distinguish.
tip.liams_modpack.access_chat_size.text: Chat Settings lets you adjust text size and the background behind messages. Larger text can make multiplayer conversations easier to follow.
tip.liams_modpack.access_sound_mix.text: Use Music & Sounds to adjust sound categories separately. Lowering one busy category can help other sounds remain audible.
tip.liams_modpack.comfort_player_tilt.te: If player tilt makes movement uncomfortable, use %s to toggle it.
tip.liams_modpack.comfort_camera_sync.te: Camera animation synchronization has its own toggle: %s. Check for a key conflict if it also triggers another action.
tip.liams_modpack.comfort_footsteps.text: Presence Footsteps has a settings screen on %s. Use it to adjust the mod's footstep audio.
tip.liams_modpack.comfort_background_fps: Dynamic FPS can reduce activity while Minecraft is unfocused. If performance changes when switching windows, check its settings.
tip.liams_modpack.atlas_open.text: Open your active atlas with %s. Check the Map Atlases category in Key Binds if the action conflicts with another mod.
tip.liams_modpack.atlas_empty_maps.text: An atlas needs spare Empty Maps to expand its coverage here. Check the Empty Maps count in its tooltip before a long trip.
tip.liams_modpack.atlas_no_paper.text: Paper alone does not refill an atlas in this pack. Use Empty Maps for its spare-map supply.
tip.liams_modpack.atlas_active_slot.text: Keep your atlas in the hotbar or a hand for it to stay active. An atlas tucked into the main inventory does not activate with these settings.
tip.liams_modpack.atlas_zoom.text: Use %s and %s to change the atlas minimap's zoom.
tip.liams_modpack.atlas_pin.text: Use the atlas's pin controls to mark your own places of interest. Short names make a busy map easier to read.
tip.liams_modpack.atlas_filter.text: The atlas screen has a marker filter. Use it to find a named marker when your map has become crowded.
tip.liams_modpack.atlas_rotate.text: The atlas minimap rotates with you by default in this pack. Use its cardinal-direction labels when comparing it with a fixed map.
tip.liams_modpack.atlas_in_hand.text: The atlas minimap is configured to hide while you hold the atlas. Put it in another hotbar slot if you want the minimap back.
tip.liams_modpack.atlas_scale.text: Map Atlases settings let you resize the minimap and the full atlas screen separately. Adjust the one that is difficult to read.
tip.liams_modpack.atlas_position.text: Map Atlases settings let you move the minimap to another corner and adjust its offset if it overlaps other information.
tip.liams_modpack.atlas_not_radar.text: The atlas maps terrain, but its mob radar is disabled in this pack. A clear map does not tell you whether an area is empty.
tip.liams_modpack.cooking_book.text: Farmer's Delight's Cooking Pot has its own recipe book. Check it when you want to cook with the ingredients you already have.
tip.liams_modpack.cooking_servings.text: Hover over a Cooking Pot item to check what it contains and how many servings remain.
To use a Farmer's Delight Cutting Board, put an item on it and interact with the appropriate tool in hand.
tip.liams_modpack.cooking_straw.text: A Farmer's Delight Knife can collect Straw from grass, wheat, or rice. Keep one with your farming supplies.
Sneak while using a Farmer's Delight Skillet to place it as a block.
tip.liams_modpack.cooking_skillet_hand.t: A held Skillet can cook food from your other hand while you stand near heat. You do not always need to place it down.
Food tooltips show effects supplied by meals. Compare those effects as well as the food itself when packing provisions.
tip.liams_modpack.cooking_nourishment.te: Nourishment slows hunger use: your food meter stays put except when saturation is used for healing.
tip.liams_modpack.cooking_comfort.text: The Comfort effect allows natural regeneration even when your food meter is low.
tip.liams_modpack.cooking_soup_stacks.te: Mushroom, beetroot, and rabbit stews stack to 16 with this pack's Farmer's Delight settings. You can pack several servings in one slot.
tip.liams_modpack.farming_rice.text: Farmer's Delight Rice is planted in shallow water. Treat it differently from crops that go on dry farmland.
tip.liams_modpack.farming_tomato_rope.te: Farmer's Delight tomatoes can climb rope placed above them. Leave some vertical space when laying out their beds.
tip.liams_modpack.farming_compost.text: Organic Compost gradually becomes Rich Soil. Sun, water, and mushrooms help the composting process.
tip.liams_modpack.farming_rope_reel.text: Sneak-use Farmer's Delight rope with an empty hand to reel it back from the bottom upward.
tip.liams_modpack.seasons_crop_growth.te: Crop growth is seasonal in this pack. If a healthy-looking crop stops growing, check whether the season suits it before rebuilding the farm.
tip.liams_modpack.seasons_bonemeal.text: Bone meal can be consumed even when seasonal conditions prevent growth. Read the failure message before trying again.
tip.liams_modpack.seasons_calendar.text: Season changes are not announced in chat here. Keep track of the season when planning what to plant.
tip.liams_modpack.seasons_breeding.text: Seasonal crop rules do not apply to animal breeding here. Ecliptic Seasons' seasonal and time-of-day breeding restrictions are disabled.
tip.liams_modpack.backpack_equip.text: Use a held Reliable Backpack to equip it when an appropriate slot is available. Aim away from replaceable blocks if you intend to equip rather than place it.
tip.liams_modpack.backpack_container_lim: Reliable Backpacks cannot be stored inside other container items. Keep a regular inventory slot available when moving one.
tip.liams_modpack.backpack_shared_access: Other players can access equipped Reliable Backpacks with this configuration. Agree on how your group will handle shared supplies.
tip.liams_modpack.backpack_death.text: An equipped Reliable Backpack is handled separately from the corpse inventory on death. Check for the backpack nearby when collecting your belongings.
tip.liams_modpack.sack_encumbrance.text: Carrying too many Supplementaries Sacks causes Overencumbered. If carrying supplies slows you down, check how many sacks you have.
tip.liams_modpack.building_vertical_slab: Quark adds Vertical Slabs for thin walls and partitions. They are separate building pieces from ordinary horizontal slabs.
tip.liams_modpack.building_vertical_conn: Walls and panes can connect to the sides of Quark Vertical Slabs with this pack's settings. Try them together when detailing a partition.
tip.liams_modpack.building_trowel.text: Quark's Trowel places a random suitable block from your hotbar. Put only the materials you want in the mix there.
tip.liams_modpack.building_wood_posts.te: Quark Wooden Posts offer a narrow alternative to full logs for beams and supports.
tip.liams_modpack.building_leaf_carpet.t: Quark Leaf Carpet provides a thin leaf layer for garden details without using a full leaf block.
Quark has ladders in different wood styles. Choose one that matches the rest of a room instead of using the same ladder everywhere.
tip.liams_modpack.building_chest_woods.t: Quark's wood-specific chests give storage rooms more palette choices. Compare their appearance before crafting a roomful.
tip.liams_modpack.decor_notice_board.tex: Supplementaries Notice Boards display maps and books. Use one for a shared map or a short set of notes at home.
tip.liams_modpack.decor_notice_board_lim: Notice Boards accept maps and books here, rather than arbitrary items. Use an Item Shelf when you want to display something else.
tip.liams_modpack.decor_blackboard.text: Use a Supplementaries Blackboard for a small drawing or label. This pack uses its black-and-white drawing mode.
tip.liams_modpack.decor_item_shelf.text: Supplementaries Item Shelves let you display items as part of a room. They are useful for showing what a nearby work area is for.
tip.liams_modpack.decor_shelf_no_climb.t: Supplementaries Item Shelves are decorative displays here, not climbable steps. Use a ladder or stairs for access.
tip.liams_modpack.decor_timber_strip.tex: An axe can remove a Supplementaries Timber Frame while leaving its contained block in place.
tip.liams_modpack.decor_planter.text: Supplementaries Planters use Farmer's Delight Rich Soil behavior in this pack. They can be part of a planted courtyard as well as decoration.
tip.liams_modpack.decor_rope_sides.text: Supplementaries rope can attach to solid block sides here. You do not have to design every rope attachment around a ceiling.
tip.liams_modpack.decor_jar_liquid.text: Supplementaries Jars can hold liquids from bottles, buckets, and bowls. Direct drinking from jars is disabled here.
tip.liams_modpack.decor_chipped_tables.t: Chipped has different workbenches for different material families. Check which workbench handles your material before setting up a decorating station.
tip.liams_modpack.decor_handcrafted.text: Handcrafted adds matching furniture in several wood styles. Compare the wood names when putting together a coordinated room.
tip.liams_modpack.create_ponder.text: Hover over a Create item that offers Ponder, then hold %s to open its animated explanation.
tip.liams_modpack.create_tooltip_summary: Create item tooltips offer a longer summary when you hold %s. Use the on-screen prompt for items that support it.
tip.liams_modpack.create_tooltip_control: Create item tooltips can show controls while you hold %s. Check them before using an unfamiliar component.
tip.liams_modpack.create_overstress.text: An overstressed Create network needs more capacity or less demand. Speeding it up is not a general fix for overload.
tip.liams_modpack.create_wrench_rotate.t: Use a Create Wrench on a component to rotate it around the clicked face. Aim at the face that matches the adjustment you need.
tip.liams_modpack.create_wrench_remove.t: Sneak-use a Create Wrench to dismantle supported components. This is a different action from rotating them.
tip.liams_modpack.create_goggles.text: Create's Engineer's Goggles add information when you look at machines, including stress impact or capacity on kinetic components.
Adjacent meshing Create cogwheels turn in opposite directions. Check their direction before connecting two branches of a mechanism.
tip.liams_modpack.create_shaft_casing.te: Andesite Casing can cover Create shafts for a tidier build.
tip.liams_modpack.create_clutch.text: A powered Create Clutch disconnects rotation. Remember that a redstone signal stops its transmission rather than starting it.
tip.liams_modpack.create_gearshift.text: A redstone signal makes a Create Gearshift reverse the transmitted rotation. It changes direction rather than acting as a stop switch.
tip.liams_modpack.create_filters.text: Create's Filter item has its own configuration interface. Use it to define a set of accepted items for components with filter slots.
tip.liams_modpack.chat_local.text: Normal text chat is local in this pack. A friend far away may not receive it even though your message appears in your own chat.
tip.liams_modpack.chat_shout.text: Use /shout for a longer-range text message. Shouting costs hunger here, and it still does not reach everywhere.
Private text messages through /tell, /msg, and /w are disabled here. Plan a meeting place before your group separates.
tip.liams_modpack.voice_settings.text: Open Simple Voice Chat with %s to check your microphone, output device, and voice settings.
tip.liams_modpack.voice_mute.text: Use %s to mute your microphone in Simple Voice Chat. Check its icon before assuming others can hear you.
tip.liams_modpack.light_temporary.text: Flimsy Torches wear down over time. Check their condition when revisiting a well-used workspace.
tip.liams_modpack.light_lantern_duration: A torch in a Flimsy Lantern lasts longer than an exposed one with this pack's settings. The lantern still needs attention over time.
tip.liams_modpack.light_campfire_fuel.te: Flimsy campfires burn down too. Keep fuel nearby if you depend on one for regular cooking.
tip.liams_modpack.revive_hold.text: To revive a downed teammate, aim at their body and hold %s and %s together. Keep looking at them until the revive finishes.
tip.liams_modpack.revive_breaks.text: Looking away, releasing the controls, or moving too far away resets revival progress. Stay close and hold the action steadily.
tip.liams_modpack.recovery_corpse_time.t: Corpses do not last forever in this pack. Make recovering your belongings a priority after a death.
tip.liams_modpack.building_rotation_lock: Quark's Rotation Lock helps place directional blocks consistently. Use %s to set a placement direction; check its indicator before continuing.
